schema.title: Response List Approvals Inbox Api V1 Approvals Inbox Get

post.description:
Approves a wipe request.

Enforces:
- Four-eyes principle: Requester can NEVER be the approver (returns 403).
- Expiration & status validity (returns 409).
- Cryptographic request fingerprint binding.
- Single-use authorization token issuance.
Rejects a wipe request with mandatory explanation comment.

Starts a wipe job by validating the single-use token and matching approval.

Negative paths enforced:
- Start without valid approval -> 409 Conflict.
- Reusing an already used approval token -> 409 Conflict.
- Fingerprint mismatch from modified request -> 409 Conflict.
